svg.title: Partial sums of the square wave Fourier series with 1, 3 and 5 odd harmonics
svg.text: Square wave from odd sine harmonics: 1, 3 and 5 terms
5 terms: (4/pi)(sin x + sin 3x/3 + sin 5x/5 + sin 7x/7 + sin 9x/9)
